name: Transported Goods 1
definition: Goods or services that are part of a commercial trade agreement.

PurchaseOrderReference.name: Purchase Order Reference
PurchaseOrderReference.definition: Reference to the purchase order of the underlying transaction.

GoodsDescription.name: Goods Description
GoodsDescription.definition: Information about the goods and/or services of a trade transaction.

BuyerDefinedInformation.name: Buyer Defined Information
BuyerDefinedInformation.definition: Information important for the users of the message/service, which cannot be captured in any other message component/element. For example: Warehouse number.

SellerDefinedInformation.definition: Information important for the users of the message/service, which cannot be captured in any other message component/element. For example: Warehouse number.
